user.title: Choose your Ulanzi light
user.description: These Ulanzi lights are in Bluetooth range. Pick the one to add.

manual.title: Enter the light's address
manual.description: No Ulanzi light was found nearby. Make sure the light is switched on and close to Home Assistant, or enter its Bluetooth address by hand.

data_description.name: The name the light advertises, e.g. starting with "Ulanzi". Used to find the light again if its address changes.

error.invalid_address: This is not a valid Bluetooth address. It should look like 5D:AA:9E:7B:9F:0B.

abort.not_supported: This device is not an Ulanzi light.

not_found.message: {name} is not in Bluetooth range. Make sure it is switched on and close to Home Assistant.

send_failed.message: Could not send the command to {name}: {error}
